visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A completed bowl of Tomato Egg Shrimp Noodle soup is presented in a bright indoor kitchen setting. The bowl is white ceramic, filled with a vibrant orange-red broth, yellow egg chunks, pink shrimp, and fresh cilantro. (2) Close-up shots show a pair of hands wearing a purple garment slicing green celery stalks diagonally on a wooden board. Following this, white onions and orange carrots are sliced into thin, uniform pieces with a sharp steel knife. (3) The hands deshell and devein fresh gray shrimp on a black work surface. In a pink pot, olive oil is poured from a blue bottle, and shrimp heads are sautéed until they turn bright red and release oils. (4) Chopped vegetables are added to the pot with the shrimp heads and stirred. Seasonings and hot water are added, and the mixture is simmered before being strained through a metal sieve to produce a clear, rich orange-tinted broth. (5) Whisked eggs are fried in a dark pan until golden and then removed. The shrimp and fresh tomato chunks are seared separately in the same pan to build flavor and release lycopene. (6) The clear broth is returned to the pot with the sautéed tomatoes and eggs to simmer. Finally, the hot soup is poured over a bowl of yellow noodles, topped with the seared shrimp and fresh cilantro garnish.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 番茄海鮮風味. [Subtitle]: 番茄炒蛋蝦湯麵. [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Variety]: 鮮美好滋味❤️. (2) [Subtitle]: 西洋芹兩支. [Subtitle]: 斜切成片. (3) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥. [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔切成片. (4) [Subtitle]: 蝦子去掉頭部. [Subtitle]: 剝去蝦殼. [Subtitle]: 蝦仁開背去掉腸泥. (5) [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱. [Subtitle]: 鍋子裡放入較多的橄欖油. [Subtitle]: 冷鍋加入蝦頭爆香. [Subtitle]: 炒到蝦頭轉紅. [Subtitle]: 蝦頭壓一下釋放出更多的蝦膏. [Subtitle]: 看到油轉紅就差不多了. [Subtitle]: 放入紅蘿蔔片、洋蔥絲、西洋芹. [Subtitle]: 蔬菜炒香炒至蔬菜都染紅. [Subtitle]: 放入蒜頭胡椒、鹽調味. [Subtitle]: 繼續炒香. [Subtitle]: 炒到蔬菜體積縮小一半再補點胡椒、綜合香料. [Subtitle]: 可以用一點煙燻紅椒粉可以讓湯色比較美. [Subtitle]: 拌炒出香氣. [Subtitle]: 加入1300~1500ml的熱水. (6) [Subtitle]: 煮滾後，轉小火約煮 15~20分鐘. [Subtitle]: 可加入一點酒，增加風味也可以省略. (7) [Subtitle]: 煮好後，過濾掉渣取出高湯使用. [Subtitle]: 擠壓一下取出更多高湯. [Subtitle]: 非常好喝的蔬菜蝦高湯就完成啦！ (8) [Subtitle]: 一旁打三顆雞蛋. [Subtitle]: 雞蛋打散. [Subtitle]: 冰箱取出處理好的蝦仁. [Subtitle]: 熱鍋2分鐘，入油. [Subtitle]: 倒入蛋液. [Subtitle]: 撥動一下蛋液. [Subtitle]: 等煎出焦香後，翻面. [Subtitle]: 壓一下，煎出焦香. [Subtitle]: 翻面過來這樣就可以起鍋了. (9) [Subtitle]: 鍋子裡補一點橄欖油. [Subtitle]: 放入蝦仁煎出焦香. [Subtitle]: 一點鹽、胡椒調味. [Subtitle]: 兩面煎一下煎到8分熟就可以起鍋了. (10) [Subtitle]: 嘿～香噴噴. [Subtitle]: 鍋子裡再補一點點. [Subtitle]: 放入番茄塊稍微炒一下. [Subtitle]: 番茄經過炒香可以釋放茄紅素會更好吃喔！ (11) [Subtitle]: 小火蓋上鍋蓋悶2分鐘關火. [Subtitle]: 將高湯倒入鍋子裡加熱. [Subtitle]: 剛剛的番茄塊放入湯裡. [Subtitle]: 鍋裡加入一瓢湯刮起鍋底的香味. [Subtitle]: 倒入湯裡. [Subtitle]: 加點剩下的紅蘿蔔. [Subtitle]: 炒過的蛋(弄成塊狀即可). [Subtitle]: 大約煮個五分鐘左右讓番茄跟蛋釋放香味. [Subtitle]: 像這樣～湯底就完成啦～～. (12) [Subtitle]: 碗裡放入燙過的油麵. [Subtitle]: 撒點香菜梗. [Subtitle]: 熱熱的湯加進來. [Subtitle]: 擺上蝦仁. [Subtitle]: 放上香菜裝飾一下～. [Subtitle]: 也可以加一點純魚露會帶有南洋風味非常好喝. [Subtitle]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track starts with an upbeat acoustic pop song at approximately 115 BPM, featuring a clear female vocal track and rhythmic acoustic guitar. A sharp, repetitive percussive hitting sound is heard as the knife chops celery on a wooden board. (2) A transition in texture occurs with the wet cracking sound of shrimp shells being removed, followed by a metallic click of an oil bottle. A loud, broadband sizzling sound swells as the shrimp heads hit the hot oil. (3) A medium-frequency pouring sound marks the addition of hot water, which settles into a continuous, low-arousal bubbling sound while the soup simmer is shown. The BGM remains dominant in the mix. (4) A sharp ceramic clack signals the cracking of eggs, followed by a fast-paced metallic whisking sound. A high-intensity sizzling erupts as the eggs are poured into the frying pan, accompanied by a soft scraping of a plastic spatula. (5) The final sequence features a large-scale liquid splashing and pouring sound as the broth is served over the noodles. Soft clinks of utensils against ceramic are heard as the dish is finished, all layered under the fading pop song.
